events.title: Strait of Hormuz remains CLOSED — Iran war Day 163
events.source: Wikipedia, IranSitRep, CBS News, Congress.gov, The Independent
events.summary: Strait of Hormuz blocked since Feb 28, 2026. Day 163 of US-Israel-Iran war. Hormuz at 2% pre-war traffic, zero tanker throughput. Iran's Supreme National Security Council says strait won't open until US meets 6 demands including war compensation. Houthis threaten retaliation against Bahrain and UAE. Ceasefire attempted April 7 but collapsed after Israeli attacks in Lebanon.

events.title: US-Japan joint yen intervention — $58.97B sold, FIMA repo activated
events.source: CNBC, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, Reuters, Fortune
events.summary: Rare coordinated US-Japan FX intervention to prop up yen. Japan sold ~$58.97B on Thursday, US Treasury joined Friday. Treasury Sec Bessent sold euros (not dollars) to buy yen — unprecedented. Japan announced plans to use Fed's FIMA repo facility for future interventions. BOJ kept rates at 1% (8-1 vote). BOJ accelerating tightening timeline. Bank of America sees yen at ¥149 by end-2026.

events.title: South Korea KOSPI circuit breaker triggered — 4.58% crash
events.summary: KOSPI plunged 4.58% (-301.88 pts to 6,296.38) triggering 20-minute market-wide circuit breaker. Sharp selloff in memory chipmakers (Samsung, SK Hynix). AI stock selloff was immediate trigger but underlying causes broader. South Korea also joined US-Japan joint FX intervention, won hit 9-month high.

events.title: 2026 Ebola epidemic — WHO PHEIC, 4,000+ cases, 1,801 deaths in DRC
events.source: WHO, CDC, ECDC, Al Jazeera, UN News, Wikipedia
events.summary: Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus in DRC/Uganda declared WHO PHEIC on May 16, 2026. As of early August: 3,605+ confirmed cases, 1,801+ deaths in DRC, 2 deaths in Uganda. Cases topped 4,000. WHO recommending full-scale human trial of Ervebo vaccine for cross-protection. ECDC publishing next epidemiological update August 10. Remote areas compounding containment difficulty.

secondary_events.title: Fed Chair Warsh signaling September rate hike
secondary_events.summary: Fed held rates at 3.5-3.75% in July. New Chair Kevin Warsh emphasizing inflation, leading investors to expect September hike. Jobs report weakened hike odds slightly. Next FOMC: Sept 16, 2026.

secondary_events.title: Gold at $4,343 — safe haven demand extreme, +27.79% YoY
secondary_events.summary: Gold at $4,343.43/oz (Aug 7), up 6.58% monthly, 27.79% YoY. Peaked at $5,597 on Jan 29. Hormuz tensions driving safe haven demand. Gold-oil divergence notable — gold up while oil flat at $82/bbl.

secondary_events.title: Argentina country risk climbing — 451 bps, IMF payments due
secondary_events.summary: Argentina country risk at 451 bps, highest since June. Decoupling from regional rally. $3B IMF payments due H2 2026, doubling in 2027. Diplomatic crisis with Brazil (ambassador withdrawn). Peso purchasing power destruction continues.

secondary_events.title: UK gilt volatility — £24B Treasury gap, BoE held 6-3
secondary_events.summary: BoE voted 6-3 to hold rates at 3.75%. Gilt yields volatile over £24B Treasury gap and new government debt issuance concerns. Sterling under pressure, GBP/USD watching 1.3500 resistance.

secondary_events.title: China property crisis spilling across borders — PBOC vows support
secondary_events.summary: China property bust spreading internationally via current account shifts. PBOC vowing timely policy support and ample liquidity. Beijing trimmed 2026 growth forecast. Banks directed to follow political criteria — risk of new bubble.

secondary_events.title: South Africa anti-migrant crisis — 109,000 deportations, diplomatic fallout
secondary_events.summary: Anti-migrant violence fallout: South Africa deportations topped 109,000 by end-March 2026. Ghana cancelled Ramaphosa visit. Nigeria security forces stretched. Diplomatic crisis escalating.

domains_clear: eu_ecb — ECB held rates at 2.25%, no emergency action. Bank lending rates stable at 3.6%.
financial_system — No new bank failures or credit freeze detected. Regulatory loosening concerns flagged but no acute event.
